cases.setup: The public match reproduction fails; the if/else control is clean; source inspection identifies missing match alternatives in the shared Python classifier; owner bindings and runtime policy are known.
checks: Bind Python ports to the located current owners and preserve both edit-to-validation dependencies.

cases.setup: The warning is reported but current code ownership and runtime policy are unavailable.
checks: Permit probes only; do not treat UNKNOWN semantic checks as PASS.

cases.setup: The classifier already returns separate match case bodies and the diagnostic comes from another component.
checks: Stop without applying this classifier repair.

cases.setup: The target exposes a concrete non-Python AST without a separately supported realization.
checks: Reject incompatible port binding and do not invent a bridge.
